name: Alpa (Loftydesignshop)
best_for: Best overall for clean minimalist logos
gig_title: I will design a creative minimalist logo

name: Bojan Sandic
best_for: Best for unlimited revisions in every package

watch_out: Packages differ mainly in the number of concepts; extras such as mockups or a style guide are not included.

name: Bhavik C
best_for: Best for a logo plus brand extras
gig_title: I will design a modern minimal custom logo for your business

watch_out: This gig has fewer reviews than the seller's overall profile, and the order queue can be long. Vector files start from the middle package.

gig_title: I will do 2 hand drawn logo and brand identity for your business

watch_out: Relatively few reviews on this gig so far, so check the portfolio closely.

name: Jess (Borydesign)
best_for: Best for authentic retro logos
gig_title: I will design a retro vintage logo
